pre_condition: rel_path is a non-empty string identifying a function (a relative path to an extracted function file). score is a numeric value. The enclosing scope provides a dict scored that maps rel_path strings to numeric values; scored may or may not already contain rel_path.
post_condition: If rel_path was not previously in scored, scored[rel_path] equals score. If rel_path was previously in scored with a value less than score, scored[rel_path] is updated to score. If rel_path was previously in scored with a value greater than or equal to score, scored[rel_path] is unchanged. No key other than rel_path is added to or removed from scored.
